question: In which year did India first participate in the Paralympic Games?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1968**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India first participated in the **Paralympic Games** in the year **1968**.
 
• The **1968 Summer Paralympics** were held in **Tel Aviv, Israel**.
 
• India was represented by a small contingent of athletes, marking its debut on the global Paralympic stage.
 
• Although India did not win any medals in its first appearance, this participation laid the foundation for future Paralympic involvement.
 
• The Paralympic Games are an **international multi-sport event** for athletes with disabilities, held parallel to the Olympic Games.
 
• India's participation in the Paralympics showcases its commitment to promoting **inclusivity in sports** and empowering athletes with disabilities.
 
• Over the years, India has made significant progress in the Paralympics, winning medals and gaining recognition for its athletes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1964**__

 __
 
• This was the year of the **Tokyo Paralympics**, but India did not participate in the Games that year.
 
 
 
• **1972**__
 __
 
• India did not participate in the **1972 Paralympics**, which were held in **Heidelberg, Germany**.
 
 
 
• **1980**__
 
 
• India did not participate in the **1980 Summer Paralympics** held in **Arnhem, Netherlands****.**
